svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.96k stars in total, about 1.26k a year earlier. mr boxington 605, aube 2050, fnox 2317, hk 1285, pitchfork 696, usage 1063, +6 more 940.
